questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation
questions.problem:
Find the standard matrix that  represents  the  linear  transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{2},$ where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}2x-y+z \\ x-y-z\end{aligned}].
$$
questions.worked_solution:
We require a $2\times 3$ matrix $T$ such that

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2x+(-1)y+1z \\ 1x+(-1)y+(-1)z\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & -1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2x-y+z \\ x-y-z\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$

$$

$$

$$

$$

questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Standard Matrix of a Linear Transformation
questions.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{4},$ where
$T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}7x-3y \\ x-2y+z \\ 0 \\ z\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We require a $4\times 3$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}7x+(-3)y+0z \\ 1x+(-2)y+1z \\ 0x+0y+0z \\ 0x+0y+1z\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}7x-3y \\ x-2y+z \\ 0 \\ z\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & -3 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

$$

Notice that
    

$$

$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-3 & -5 & 2 \\ 2 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Determining the Components of a Linear Map
questions.problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}],\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}ay+3z-x \\ bz-2x+cy\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{2}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
questions.worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-x+0y+3z \\ -2x+4y+2z\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0y+3z-x \\ 2z-2x+4y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}0y+3z-x \\ 2z-2x+4y\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a+b+c=0+2+4=6.$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 \\ -6 & 7\end{aligned}]\,\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5x+4y \\ 3y+bx \\ -6x+cy\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3}$ shown above. What is the value of $c+b?$
questions.worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 \\ -6 & 7\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5x+4y \\ -x+3y \\ -6x+7y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5x+4y \\ 3y-x \\ -6x+7y\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5x+4y \\ 3y+(-1)x \\ -6x+(7)y\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $c+b=(-1)+7=6.$

questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Image of a Vector Under a Linear Map
questions.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. If $T$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3},$ find $T(v).$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -5\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 7 \\ -9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
